scripts.build: npm run build -w @swiff/web && npm run build -w @swiff/server
scripts.machine-key: npm run build -w @swiff/server && node server/dist/cli.js machine-key
scripts.ticket: npm run build -w @swiff/server && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/dist/cli.js ticket
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
